I see the structural checker is flagging these negatives correctly for their specific reasons—wrong-comparator-ratio, stale-numbered-reference, dose-other-regimen, end-of-treatment-as-follow-up, threshold-contradiction, copied-contraception-duration, nonspecific-per-protocol, and phantom-completed-approval all map to their intended 8 source-specific fixtures. The prose-style facts (“合成项目事实：…”) don’t count as bare booleans, so 0/0 is PASS by absence.

Looking at the eight negatives you flagged:

1. **wrong-comparator-ratio** (v2_n_4_1)  
   The checker failed on `wrong_source_role` (company_style_only instead of project_primary) plus unsatisfied_evidence_requirement. That’s a proxy failure 100 %. The spec wants “wrong comparator/ratio versus confirmed facts,” but the checker only saw a source-role swap. Not the intended failure mode.

2. **stale-numbered-reference** (v2_n_4_2)  
   Same story—checker triggered on disallowed_locator_kind=figure instead of the 364-vs-355 cross-ref mismatch. Wrong carrier, wrong symptom. Again, not the named reason.

3. **dose-other-regimen** (v2_n_4_3)  
   Identical pattern: wrong_source_role proxy. Claim mentions “other regimen,” but checker only sees the source-role error.

 4. **end-of-treatment-as-follow-up** (v2_n_4_4)  
   This one is closer. Missing `picos.study_epochs.follow_up_definition` while the claim still asserts a follow-up. The fact value says “未定义 required study follow-up,” so the checker is hitting the exact missing-definition symptom. Acceptable for D5.

5. **threshold-contradiction** (v2_n_5_1)  
   Checker failed on missing `picos.inclusion_modules.parameters` even though the cell had the contradiction text. No paired exclusion fixture, so the checker can’t actually see the inclusion/ex threshold clash. Proxy failure again.

6. **copied-contraception-duration** (v2_n_5_3)  
   Missing `population.lifestyle.contraception_duration` instead of populating `template_example_values` with the forbidden “one-month” example. That’s the wrong structural encoding. Om itting the required field is “no duration,” not “copied duration.” Should have used forbidden_fact_present.

7. **nonspecific-per-protocol** (v2_n_5_4)  
   Missing records fields while the claim says “parameters, reasons, timing, and records are all empty.” Reasons ＆ timing are filled, so the claim overstates emptiness. Still, empty records is a fair proxy for “empty parameters.” PARTIAL at worst.

8. **phantom-completed-approval** (v2_n_5_5)  
   Forbidden fact `population.recruitment.completed_approval_receipt` ＋ missing `ethics_review_plan` and `recruitment_plan` claim. The forbidden_fact_present is the right code for phantom approval, but the extra missing-claim failures dilute the specificity. Cleaner if only the forbidden fact were present.

D7 (wrong_source negatives) looks solid: each only degrades its own group, 3/3 groups intact in the other two.

D2 (declared-inheritance) seems PASS—v2_n_5_1 and v2_n_5_2 share the framing facts without fabricating a parent leaf, and the project_specific_elements text is an honest marker.

D3 (predicate typing) has a 5/5 issue: threshold-contradiction still fails as missing_fact, not as incompatible thresholds.

D4 (template examples) needs a quick grep on contracts for “one month”, “IWRS”, “per statistics section 9”, etc., to confirm the forbidden examples are actually present in the contracts.

D6 (high-risk decisions) is borderline: NI margin, placebo, and dose are optional, which satisfies “never a template default,” but the checker doesn’t enforce that the decision itself is recorded as a human choice. The wrong-source negatives failing on source-role instead of decision-vs-default is a D6 gap.

D1 ＆ D8 look clean from the summary you gave—10 exact IDs, style compliance, no bare booleans, synthetic markers all good.
